headline: ‘Julian’ Review: Getting Married in 22 Countries
context: Cato Kusters’ feature debut recounts the abbreviated love story of the Belgian artist Fleur Pierets and her wife, Julian Boom, as they fight for gay rights abroad.

sources.name: The New York Times
